question: In which of these drugs with antiviral activity does an open structure of acyclonucleoside appear ?:
analysis: Acyclonucleosides are a class of antiviral drugs that have a specific open structure. Among the options provided, Ganciclovir is known to have an acyclonucleoside structure, which is characterized by the absence of a sugar moiety. Zidovudine, Ribavirin, and Lamivudine do not fit this description as they contain sugar components in their structures.
